limitations: Markdown rendering is a documented first-party subset; rich edits can normalize supported syntax. Source mode preserves unsupported extensions.
MCP uses manually supplied bearer tokens; OAuth-only remote clients are not supported.
Password reset delivery is not configured and its UI remains hidden.
Browser storage clearing removes guest-only documents.
